metadata.title: Jainav Infotech: software products and custom software
metadata.description: Jainav Infotech builds its own software products, MenuMesh, VYRO and Baby, and custom software for businesses. Based in Indore, India.

home.title: Software we build, and software we build for you.
home.subtitle: Products like MenuMesh, VYRO and Baby, plus custom software for your business. The full site is on its way.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Deleting your account anonymizes your profile (your name, phone and billing details are removed) and signs you out on every device. Your orders and invoices are kept for the period tax law requires.
delete.confirmText: Your profile will be anonymized and every session ends. Orders and invoices are kept for the period tax law requires. This can't be undone.
